summary: Iteration 313: tested the Import Exception Resolution Centre, Coordinator Daily View, contract editor (instalment amount, save state, Sicon labels), invoice-run preview, the backup tests and a regression pass. Testing used the public URL, with the coordinator, aftersales manager and finance accounts, at 1920x1080 and 1366x768. I seeded the fictional mmt_ui_master.xlsx and committed it through the UI as the manager: 6 created, 1 held, 0 failed. Cleanup is done (0 MMT contracts, companies or uploads left). The real upload e7a84748 was only read and is unchanged: state 'ready', 0 committed rows, 0 corrections or decisions. Backend: test_cm_maintenance_master.py 3/3 pass; new test_mm_api_iter313.py 5/5 pass. On the real upload, 1139 rows are unresolved and 797 match 'contract number'. Of those 797, 786 are actually missing a number and 11 are duplicates (see minor bug). Resolution centre works: the import_exceptions card turns on 'Unresolved only' (3 rows). The q filter works. The panel shows the problems and the original workbook cells. Save correction stays disabled until there is a value and a reason. Correcting the Delta row (number MMT-1005, dates, amount 800) changed it from Missing information to New contract. Its raw cells stayed unchanged in the UI and the DB, and the corrections and decision log show who made them and why. 'Not a duplicate' appears only on duplicate rows, needs a reason, and moved the row to New contract. 'Do not import' needs a reason and logs the decision, and the skipped row was NOT committed (held: 'skipped by coordinator'). Undo decision appears after a decision. Customer search returns results. The Unresolved items export downloads. Commit confirm dialog works. Contract editor: mm-edit-state shows 'Unsaved changes' while typing, then 'Saved · revision 2'. After a reload, instalment_amount=75 and its history are still there. The Sicon label reads 'Held for Sicon' after reload. The coordinator sees no approve or commit buttons. Daily view: all 9 cards show counts. Clicking a card toggles its list. Clicking an item filled mm-contracts-search with MMT-1002 and scrolled there. The coordinator selector filters most cards. Invoice run: the period picker, totals, table and xlsx export (Summary + Invoice run sheets) work. The page says 'Preview only' and 'VAT: not configured — not calculated'. Annual MMT-1001 shows £1,500 (the annual value). Monthly MMT-1002 had a blank amount and 'needs information' until the instalment was set, then showed £75. Regression: the Service planner, Build Quote and Finance dashboard all render. Main problems: (1) the invoice run proposes £4,000 (40 rows) from billing schedules whose contracts no longer exist, with blank contract and customer; (2) the daily 'Service visits needing attention' shows 107 from orphan schedules, while the Service planner shows 0; (3) the Sicon label does not refresh after 'Approve for Sicon queue'; (4) GET /crm/v2/contracts/workspace returns 404 and shows up as console errors.

critical.issue: The invoice run proposes invoices for contracts that do not exist. All 60 crm2_afs_billing docs in the org point to deleted contracts (likely leftover test data). For 2026-11 it proposes 40 invoices and £4,000 net with blank Contract and Customer; for 2026-12 it is 41 invoices and £5,500. Cause: invoice_run uses `c = contracts.get(...) or {}` and still marks the row 'proposed'. It also never checks the contract's status (cancelled or expired). Fix: skip these rows, or set them to needs_information with the warning 'contract not found', and only propose for live contracts. This breaks the 'never fabricate data' rule.

minor.issue: The service_attention card counts visits in crm2_afs_service_schedules without checking that the contract still exists. All 60 schedules (242 visits) are orphans, so the card shows 107 while the Service planner shows 0 due or overdue. It also ignores the coordinator filter: with a coordinator chosen, the query uses only {organization_id} and still shows 107. Its items have no contract_number, so clicking them does nothing.

The issue is matched as a regex substring, so 'Contract number missing' also matches 'contract number appears on more than one live row'. On the real upload it returns 797, but only 786 rows are actually missing a number; the other 11 are duplicates. Fix: use the option value 'contract number missing', or match the problem text exactly.

A skipped row ('Do not import') is classified again as new_contract. It counts in 'New contract · 7' and in the commit confirm dialog ('New contracts: 7', but 6 were created and 1 was held). The commit itself correctly holds it ('skipped by coordinator'). Fix: give skipped rows their own class or count, or leave them out of new_contract.

Returns 404 {'detail':'Contract not found'} with a valid token, because the /contracts/{id} route is matched first (route_registry ordering). It causes 2–4 console 404 errors on every Contract Management load, and useWorkspaceMode silently falls back to 'enterprise'. Fix: register crm_contract_workspace_router before the contracts router.

Restore only inserts: documents that already exist with the same _id are skipped and never overwritten. So restoring over a bad edit does not bring back the old values. Backup also loads whole collections into memory. Document this, or add an --overwrite option.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Approve for Sicon queue', mm-sync-state and the list's Sicon column keep the old label ('Local only — Sage account needed') until the page is reloaded; then they show 'Held for Sicon'. queue() does not call load()/onSaved(). The toast shows the raw state ('held writes disabled').

After a correction, the row still shows the original mapped values: Contract '—' and term '2026-02-01 → ?' for the corrected Delta row (MMT-1005). The table uses r.mapped instead of the effective (corrected) values.
When a correction resolves the row, it drops out of the filtered list right away and its open panel disappears. The user sees only a toast, not the new class or the decision log.
openRow is kept when the filters change. Clicking a row that was open before a filter change closes it instead of opening it.

integration_issues.issue: CoordinatorDailyView refetches only when the coordinator changes. After a commit, correction or contract save, its counts and the coordinator list stay stale (a new coordinator appeared only after a reload).

issues: cm-invoice-period uses the browser's native <input type=month> instead of the app's picker styling
Rows with blank Contract/Customer appear (from the orphan billing data)
No overlapping text or hidden actions found in the daily cards, resolution panel, editor or invoice table. The cookie banner covers the bottom-right corner until it is dismissed.

action_items: invoice_run: do not propose billing rows whose contract is missing or not live; flag them instead (HIGH)
daily_view service_attention: ignore orphan schedules, apply the coordinator filter, and include contract_number in the items
ContractEditor.queue(): reload the contract and the list after queueing so the 'Held for Sicon' label shows at once
Issue filter option 'Contract number missing' should match only the 'contract number missing' text
Leave skipped rows out of the new_contract counts and the commit confirm dialog
Fix the /crm/v2/contracts/workspace route order (404 console errors)
Show effective (corrected) values in the preview rows; refresh the daily view after changes; add data-testids to the daily list items
critical_code_review_comments: crm_maintenance_master.py is 1084 lines; split it (daily/invoice-run, resolution, commit, exports)
invoice_run loads every org contract into memory; filter by historical_import, live status or id-in-billing
daily_view runs 7 count+find query pairs one after another; use asyncio.gather
cm_backup.py restore never overwrites existing docs (only additive)

success_rate.backend: 90% (8/8 pytest pass; 1 high and 5 minor logic issues)

seed_data_creation: mm_ui_seed.py seed (fictional mmt_ui_master.xlsx), committed via the UI, then removed with mm_ui_seed.py cleanup. Nothing is left behind. I did not create, change or delete the orphan crm2_afs_billing or crm2_afs_service_schedules docs; they were already there.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: /login?next=/contract-management (gx-login-email + input[type=password] + Enter), then crm-nav-contracts. Clear the rate limit with `python tests/_clear_login_ratelimit.py`. Flow: mm_ui_seed.py seed → as manager, correct the Delta row (missing_information) → accept_dup/skip on the MMT-1003 duplicates → tick mm-create-customers, click mm-commit, accept the dialog with an async handler → set the instalment on MMT-1002 → invoice-run for 2026-12 → cleanup. Expected real upload values: 1139 unresolved, 786 truly missing a number. Org has 60 orphan billing schedules and 60 orphan service schedules. Never commit e7a84748.
